body:
## Bug

https://qelectrotech.org/bugtracker/view.php?id=245

When a title block template cell contains a bare `%name` custom-variable placeholder (as opposed to the braced `%{name}` form), it isn't detected when the template is selected in Project Properties — the "Custom" tab doesn't get auto-populated with an entry for it. This fails both for a single bare variable with a trailing space (`%name2 `) and for two bare variables in the same cell (`%name2 %name3`). Manually adding the variable in Project Properties works and renders correctly.

## Root cause

`TitleBlockTemplate::listOfVariables()` (`sources/titleblocktemplate.cpp`) — which scans a template's cells to auto-populate the Custom tab (a feature recently added by another contributor, see `TitleBlockPropertiesWidget::addTemplateVariables()`) — only matched the braced `%{name}` form:

```cpp
static const QRegularExpression rx(QStringLiteral("%\\{([^}]+)\\}"));
```

The bare `%name` form is a fully legitimate, already-supported substitution syntax — `TitleBlockTemplate::interpreteVariables()` already replaces both forms when rendering — but `listOfVariables()` never matched it at all. Both reported symptoms are really the same underlying gap: any cell using only the bare form produces zero detected variables, not "first only" or "trailing space breaks it" specifically.

## Fix

Extend the regex to also match a bare `%name` as the longest run of identifier characters immediately after `%`, via a second alternative/capture group. This naturally stops at whitespace, so `%name2 ` and `%name2 %name3` are both now correctly detected — no change to existing braced-form handling, and the existing `globalMatch()` loop already correctly finds multiple matches per cell.

## Verification

- Clean rebuild: only the intended object file recompiled, linked successfully.
- Wrote a standalone test of the regex/extraction logic covering exactly the reported repro cases — `%name2`, `%name2 ` (trailing space), `%name2 %name3` (two bare variables), `%{name2}` (braced, unaffected), a braced+bare mix, plain text with no variables, and two built-in-style names — all extracted correctly with no regression to the previously-working braced form.
- **Not verified**: the actual Project Properties "Custom" tab UI auto-populating live end-to-end, since exercising the full Xvfb GUI flow was out of scope given the extraction logic itself was already precisely verified in isolation.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
